site.taglineSr: Fotografije mesta koja su mi nešto značila
site.taglineEn: Photographs of places that meant something to me
site.aboutSr:
Zovem se Katarina i fotografija je moj način da sačuvam trenutke, ljude i mesta koja me inspirišu.

[Ovde napiši par rečenica o sebi — šta voliš da fotografišeš, čime fotografišeš, kuda bi volela da odeš sledeće.]
site.aboutEn:
My name is Katarina and photography is my way of keeping the moments, people and places that inspire me.

[Write a few sentences about yourself here — what you love to photograph, what you shoot with, where you would like to go next.]
